title: Debounce helper
content: export const debounce = (fn, ms) => { let t; return (...a) => { clearTimeout(t); t = setTimeout(() => fn(...a), ms) } }

title: SQL: top clips by day
content: SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at) AS d, count(*) FROM clips GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT 14;
